title: seams show and render --status
description: Each seam's rung on the coverage ladder, and its gaps, as another tool judged them. Sheepdog writes it; seams only reads it, so seams never judges practices.

seams.description: Each rated seam, by its id, or by an id it had before a rename.

rung.description: The highest rung the seam has reached: 0, none; 1, the seam, its parties and audience are known; 2, a versioned, linted contract exists; 3, each change is checked for compatibility against trunk and the last release; 4, the consumer tests against the contract; 5, the provider is verified against it; 6, a deploy gate exists where the sides deploy separately.

gaps.description: What the seam lacks to climb, most pressing first.
